ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
As shown in the figure, electric power workers perform live-line work on high-voltage lines of several million volts. The electricians wear live-line work shielding suits over their whole bodies. The shielding suit is clothing made after conductive metal materials and textile fibers are blended and interwoven into cloth. Which of the following statements is correct? (　　)
A. The purpose of using clothing woven with metal materials is to make the clothing not easily torn
B. The purpose of using clothing woven with metal materials is to use electrostatic shielding
C. After the electrician puts on the shielding suit, the field strength inside the body is zero
D. After the electrician puts on the shielding suit, the electric potential inside the body is zero

ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: When electric power workers perform live-line work on high-voltage lines of several million volts, the shielding clothing they wear is woven from conductive metal material. What physical principle is used?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: In the image, it can be seen that electric power workers are working on multiple overhead high-voltage conductors. The workers are wearing live-line work clothing that covers the body and are in an environment close to or in contact with high-voltage conductors. The problem statement explains that this shielding clothing is woven from conductive metal material, and its purpose is to protect the human body from the influence of the strong electric field around the high-voltage conductors. According to physics knowledge, when a conductor reaches electrostatic equilibrium, charge is mainly distributed on the outer surface, and the electric field inside the conductor is zero; a conductive shell or conductive mesh can make its internal space unaffected by an external electric field, and this phenomenon is called electrostatic shielding. Therefore the physical principle used by this shielding clothing is electrostatic shielding.

method.method_draft: 从题干读取关键信息：电力工作人员在几百万伏高压线上带电作业，所穿服装是由导电金属材料编织成的“屏蔽服”。结合图中工作人员直接接触高压导线作业的场景，判断该服装需要保护人体免受强电场影响。利用物理知识：导体在静电平衡时电荷分布在外表面，导体内部电场为零，导电外壳或导电网能使内部空间不受外电场影响，这一现象称为静电屏蔽。因此答案为“静电屏蔽”。

raw_record.original_question: 电力工作人员在几百万伏的高压线上进行带电作业时，所穿屏蔽服采用导电金属材料编织，利用了什么物理原理？
raw_record.final_cot: In the image, it can be seen that electric power workers are working on multiple overhead high-voltage conductors. The workers are wearing live-line work clothing that covers the body and are in an environment close to or in contact with high-voltage conductors. The problem statement explains that this shielding clothing is woven from conductive metal material, and its purpose is to protect the human body from the influence of the strong electric field around the high-voltage conductors. According to physics knowledge, when a conductor reaches electrostatic equilibrium, charge is mainly distributed on the outer surface, and the electric field inside the conductor is zero; a conductive shell or conductive mesh can make its internal space unaffected by an external electric field, and this phenomenon is called electrostatic shielding. Therefore the physical principle used by this shielding clothing is electrostatic shielding.
